frontmatter.title: Stage ordering and lowering
frontmatter.description: Canonical ordering from resolved source through lowering into a backend-ready CodegenArtifact.

This feature hub defines the stage ordering contract for parse, semantic gates, HIR/resolution/typing, and Cranelift lowering into `CodegenArtifact`.

## Decisions

No open decisions. Closed choices are normative ADRs under **`adr/`** (`D-COMP-BUILD-0016` … `D-COMP-BUILD-0018`); use the reader **ADRs** tab for expandable detail.
